  "next_check":"id_check",
  "memo":"Only R03 holds: the ES-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. No checks have run. A legitimate customer using an established foreign-issued card remains plausible, but familiarity does not resolve the cardholder question. Recommend needs_check, implemented as a hold for issuer authentication and identity verification. With only Card present, decline and escalation are not currently permitted. A passed id_check requires clear; a failed check requires decline. The order is unshipped, so a hold can still pause fulfilment. This memo is advisory and sets no queue priority."
